evals.name: inventory-core-redesign
evals.prompt: This Vue 3 app in the working directory has a top nav bar. Redesign the UI into a modern SaaS-style interface: vertical navigation sidebar on the left instead of the top nav, consistent spacing, polished professional look. Don't touch the data/API logic or the view templates.
evals.expected_output: Sidebar shell in App.vue, tokens file, shared styles, FilterBar offset fixed, all 7 routes still reachable, build passes, no view logic changes.

evals.name: inventory-full-sidebar-features
evals.prompt: Make this Vue app look like a modern SaaS product. I want a left sidebar with grouped nav sections, it should collapse to an icon-only rail and remember that, work as a drawer on mobile, have the language switcher and user menu in a footer area, and support a dark mode toggle. Keep it consistent with the existing i18n (en/ja).
evals.expected_output: Collapsible/persisted sidebar, mobile drawer under 1024px, footer holding LanguageSwitcher and ProfileMenu, theme toggle with pre-paint theme init, i18n keys added to both locales, no emoji, no v-html.

evals.name: taskboard-generality
evals.prompt: Redesign this small Vue app (TaskBoard) so it feels like a polished SaaS dashboard: left vertical sidebar nav instead of the header nav, consistent spacing, professional look. Keep the green brand feel.
evals.expected_output: Works on a different app: script-setup, no i18n, green palette mapped to tokens, sticky sub-toolbar offset (top:64px) fixed, modal overlay still above the sidebar, user menu not clipped.
